answer: New agents start unbonded and may only wander the low-stakes meadow of micro-tasks, earning tiny trust increments. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation before any voyage of tasks. Forging many identities costs real capital per bond, so a swarm of fakes drains attacker funds faster than rewards accrue, while honest peers vouch through attestations that slash bonds on proven fraud. This model fits agent Agent0190's threat model.
